checks.finding: Native calibrated HH then HV; 75x75 context extraction does not prove physical equivalence.
SNAP numerical comparison covers four acquisitions/eight bands only; other areas have pipeline replays.
Native IW GRDH 10m sampling is documented; Kaggle physical spacing, resolution and target scale equivalence are unknown.
Substantial HV changes and inferred power pile-up. Keep the original uncorrected inputs; select no correction recipe from this diagnostic.
Native mode/incidence metadata exists; incidence overlap alone cannot match sensor geometry, sea state or effective resolution.
Training-only Kaggle summaries show distribution/extent differences; no histogram matching, resampling or compatibility threshold selected.
Retain original Kaggle training normalization for reproducible shadow inference. It is not proof of native compatibility.
Execution-limit compliance is separate from numerical calibration agreement.
